intended_object: The homotopy group π_N(X, x): homotopy classes rel boundary of maps from the cube I^N to X that send the boundary ∂I^N to the basepoint x. This comes from the docstring and the module.
explanation:
`GenLoop N X x` is the set of continuous maps I^N → X that send every point of `Cube.boundary N` to x. `GenLoop.Homotopic` is homotopy relative to the cube boundary. The quotient is therefore the standard cube-model definition of π_n(X, x), and N can be any index type (`Fin n` gives π_n).

The degenerate case also comes out right. When N is empty, I^0 is a point and its boundary is empty, so the quotient is the set of path components of X, which is π_0.

Group structures are added later in the file through instances (for nonempty N), so this definition is only the underlying type. That is the right design. Nothing more general exists in Mathlib; this is Mathlib's own definition.
